details:
Q1: `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED` does not exist in `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml`, `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` or anywhere else. How should it be introduced?
Choices:
A) Add it as a new repo variable read by both release workflows, defaulting to `false`. Until it is set to `true`, every gate run (including `auto-release-stable.yml` and the promote cycle) validates and checks CI but tags and releases nothing. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Add it defaulting to `true`, so releases keep working and the switch only takes effect when set to `false`.
C) Don't add a switch; only add the CI / lint gate.
Q2: When `STABLE_RELEASE_ENABLED` is off, what happens to the changelog step (fragments folded into `CHANGELOG.md` and pushed to `stable`)?
Choices:
A) Skip the changelog push too, so a disabled run writes nothing to `stable` and leaves the fragments for the next enabled run. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Still run the CI gate and push the changelog to `stable`; skip only tagging, the release, consumer dispatch and sync-to-main.
